Diagnosis: Mixed 'freeze_orientation' with other orientation constraints ('axis_align'), which is not allowed per the error message and TermAPI rules.
Reasoning: Success for this subtask requires: (1) moving the marker (while grasped) so its center is within 0.01 m laterally in world x and y above the pen_holder center, (2) keeping the marker elevated by at least 0.165 m above the pen_holder center along world +z, (3) aligning the marker's longitudinal (+y) axis parallel to the pen_holder's +z axis, (4) maintaining the orientation between tool and marker fixed (no slip), and (5) keeping a closed gripper to prevent slip/release. However, according to the TermAPI and error message, freeze_orientation cannot be used together with axis_align. Thus, axis_align (which aligns marker +y to pen_holder +z with the required tolerance and indirectly ensures proper orientation for the manipulation) is sufficient here for the orientation requirement. All constraints are combined with 'and' because all listed requirements must be satisfied simultaneously.
